description:
Build the Path Forward 

 At Path Robotics, we’re building the future of embodied intelligence. Our AI-driven systems enable robots to adapt, learn, and perform in the real world, closing the skilled labor gap and transforming industries. We go beyond traditional methods, combining perception, reasoning, and control to deliver field-ready AI that is risk-aware, reliable, and continuously improving through real-world use.

 Big, hard problems are our everyday work, and our team of intelligent, humble, and driven people make the impossible possible together.

 We’re seeking Robotics Software Engineers who thrive on making big, complex systems work together in the real world. We currently have experienced and senior openings on the team. Our robots combine industrial hardware, real-time C++ control, ROS, cloud services, and the latest machine learning research. This team ties all of it into one reliable product and scales it from a few cells to dozens of systems running in production on customer factory floors. You’ll write the drivers, ROS nodes, deployment tooling, and telemetry that make that possible. You’ll be hands-on with the robots, bringing systems up, debugging them, and working with factory technicians to keep them running. 

 What You’ll Do 

 Experienced: 

 
 Write drivers for robotic and industrial hardware. Build and maintain the drivers that connect our software to robot controllers, sensors, cameras, PLCs, and other industrial equipment, behind clean, reliable interfaces.

 Ship software to the fleet. Package software in Docker, and build and improve the deployment, configuration, and update tooling that gets it onto dozens of robots reliably.

 Get research onto the robot. Help integrate and deploy new machine learning models and features from our research teams onto real robotic hardware.

 Bring up and support systems on the factory floor. Install, test, and troubleshoot systems with factory technicians, including networking and connectivity issues, and turn what you learn into fixes in the code.

 Write solid, tested code. Contribute unit and integration tests, participate in code reviews, and help keep CI/CD healthy.

 
 Senior: 

 
 Connect the full stack. Own the integration layer across modern C++, Python, ROS 1/2, Docker, AWS, web services, and industrial robot controllers, so that new capabilities reach the robot cleanly and reliably.

 Get research into production. Partner with our machine learning and research teams to package, deploy, and run new learning-based models on real robotic hardware.

 Scale from a handful of cells to a fleet. Build the deployment, configuration, and update infrastructure that takes development and demonstration systems to dozens of robots in production.

 Architect large systems. Organize and design how large numbers of robotic hardware and software components fit together: interfaces, ownership boundaries, versioning, and deployment.

 Build consensus across teams. Work with hardware, controls, perception, ML, cloud, and field operations teams to understand their needs, propose integration solutions, and bring stakeholders to agreement.

 Mentor engineers. Provide technical leadership and help experienced engineers grow their system design skills.

 
 Who You Are 

 
 A Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

 3+ years (Experienced) / 6+ years (Senior) building software in modern C++ (Python a strong plus), with hands-on work on robots or other physical hardware.

 Experience with ROS 2.

 Familiarity with ROS, DDS, gRPC, and other communications middleware.

 Comfortable with multithreading, concurrency, and debugging systems-level behavior on real hardware.

 Fluent developing and operating software on Linux, with Git.

 You enjoy hands-on work and are willing to spend time on the factory floor with the robots.

 Senior: A track record of shipping and supporting industrial robotic systems in production. Experience writing drivers or hardware interfaces, deploying containerized software with Docker on AWS or similar platforms, and handling telemetry, remote management, networking, and security for deployed systems. Experience designing large systems of robotics hardware and software, and comfort leading cross-team technical discussions to a decision.

 
 Why You’ll Love Working Here 

 
 Daily free lunch to keep you fueled and connected with the team

 Flexible PTO so you can take the time you need, when you need it

 Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

 6 weeks fully paid parental leave, plus an additional 6–8 weeks for birthing parents (12–14 weeks total)

 401(k) retirement plan through Empower

 Generous employee referral bonuses—help us grow our team!

 
 Who We Are 

 At Path Robotics we love coming to work to solve interesting and tough challenges but also because our ideas are welcomed and valued. We encourage unique thinking and are dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

 If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application process or any part of the hiring process, please contact HR@path-robotics.com. We are committed to providing equal access and will work with qualified individuals to ensure a fair and accessible hiring experience. We will respond to your request within 48 hours.
